title: Establishment of Murine Orthotopic Lung Tumors and Assessment of Pulmonal Metastasis by Flow Cytometry
author: Zaun, Liu, et al.
materials: 1.Prepare stock solutions of label retention dyes (e.g., CFSE and CTV)2 according to manufacturer’s instructions. (https://assets.thermofisher.com/TFS-Assets/LSG/manuals/MAN0002595_CellTrace_Cell_Proliferation_Kits_UG.pdf).2.Prepare Matrigel aliquots according to manufacturer’s protocol and freeze aliquots of 150 μL at −20°C. (https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/DE/de/technical-documents/protocol/cell-culture-and-cell-culture-analysis/3d-cell-culture/corning-matrigel-basement-membrane-matrix-for-3d-culture-in-vitro).

Timing: approximately 4 h
Note: For label retention dyes perform resection of lungs within 1–7 days after injection.
29.Prepare 10 × 50 mL Falcon tubes with 10 mL of 1× DPBS and label them for mouse 1–5, left and right lung separately.30.Sacrifice the mice according to standard local facility protocol.31.Resect left lung (primary tumor injection site) and right lung (metastatic side) of animals and place in separate Falcon tubes.32.Place organs in 6 well plates (one whole lung per well, meaning left and right lungs always kept in separate wells).33.Mince tissues using scissors and digest in 1 mL trypsin supplemented with 100 μg/mL Liberase (Sigma-Aldrich) and 200 μg/mL Deoxyribonuclease I (Sigma-Aldrich) for 30 min incubation at 37°C 5% CO2.34.Resuspend organs in DMEM containing 5% FCS and pipette up-and down 3 times.35.Pass the organ suspension through a 40 μM cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube.36.Pellet the cells by spinning down at 400–800 g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Optional: Stain cells for surface markers CD45-APC and CD31-PECy7 for 20 min at 4°C (use antibodies in 1:100 dilution).
37.Perform erythrocyte lysis with ACK buffer at room temperature for 2–5 min according to manufacturer’s protocol.38.Wash cells in FACS Buffer before FACS analysis.39.Pellet the cells by spinning down at 400–800 g for 5 min, discard supernatant.40.Resuspend cells in 400 μL FACS Buffer.41.Pass the cells through a cell strainer into a FACS tube to ensure a single cell suspension.42.Trypsinize single color stained cells from 6 well plate and unstained cells from cell culture, and resuspend in 300 μL FACS buffer (to be used later as single-color FACS controls).43.Perform flow cytometry. This protocol has been successfully executed using an AURORA 3 L and 4 L. However, it will be applicable to other Cytometers.

steps.title: Prepare label retention dye stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare stock solutions of CFSE and CTV according to the manufacturers’ instructions.

steps.title: Prepare Matrigel aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot Matrigel into 150 µL portions and freeze at –20 °C following the supplier’s protocol.

steps.title: Skip labeling if using fluorescent proteins
steps.instruction: If the cell lines express fluorescent proteins, omit the dye‑labeling steps and instead make separate suspensions of each line containing 5 × 10⁶ cells in 125 µL complete medium (sufficient for up to 5 mice), then continue with the downstream steps.

steps.title: Label Falcon tubes for lung collection
steps.instruction: Prepare ten 50 mL Falcon tubes, add 10 mL 1× DPBS to each, and label them for mice 1–5, left and right lungs separately.

steps.title: Euthanize mice and harvest lungs
steps.instruction: Sacrifice the mice according to the local facility protocol, resect the left lung (injection site) and the right lung (metastatic side), and place each lung into its pre‑labeled Falcon tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each lung to a separate well of a 6‑well plate (one lung per well).
Add 1 mL trypsin containing 100 µg/mL Liberase and 200 µg/mL DNase I.
Incubate for 30 min at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂.
Add DMEM with 5 % FCS and pipette up‑and‑down three times.
Pass the suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer into a 50 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge at 400–800 g for 5 min, discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Optional surface marker staining
steps.instruction: If desired, stain the cells with CD45‑APC and CD31‑PE‑Cy7 (1:100 dilution) for 20 min at 4 °C, then proceed.

steps.title: Lyse erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Treat the cell pellet with ACK lysis buffer at room temperature for 2–5 min according to the manufacturer’s protocol, then wash with FACS buffer.

steps.title: Wash and resuspend cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Prepare the cells for flow cytometry:

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400–800 g for 5 min and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 400 µL FACS buffer.
Pass the suspension through a cell strainer into a FACS tube to ensure a single‑cell suspension.

steps.title: Prepare single‑color FACS controls
steps.instruction: Trypsinize single‑color stained cells from the 6‑well plate and unstained culture cells, then resuspend each in 300 µL FACS buffer for use as single‑color controls.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Run all samples on a flow cytometer (e.g., Aurora 3L or 4L) using appropriate laser and detector settings for the fluorophores.

steps.title: Optimize instrument with unstained control
steps.instruction: Begin with the unstained sample to set voltage, gating, and compensation matrix.

steps.title: Gate cell populations and exclude unwanted cells
steps.instruction: Identify singlet cells; optionally exclude CD45‑APC⁺ and CD31‑PE‑Cy7⁺ events to remove lymphocytes and endothelial cells.

steps.title: Identify cancer cells by dye fluorescence
steps.instruction: Plot CFSE or CTV fluorescence versus SSC and gate the CFSE⁺/CTV⁺ population as cancer cells.

steps.title: Calculate metastatic ratio
steps.instruction: Compute the ratio of CFSE⁺ (or CTV⁺) cell count in the contralateral lung divided by the count in the injected lung to quantify metastatic capacity.
